identity.title: Prevent prior Review output layers from becoming new Run inputs

origin.kind: scheduled 2D task execution and source review
origin.summary: 2D-012 requires a new Pipeline Review run to distinguish external input layers from images produced by a prior run or declared as current pipeline outputs after a producer is deleted, disabled, or reordered.

state.current_summary: Pipeline Review now seeds only eligible external display layers. Current effective-pipeline outputs and output layers observed from earlier Review runs are excluded from the next Run context, while an existing ALLOW_BRANCH_INPUT=true step may explicitly opt a prior layer back in; Main remains the default external source.

claims.text: CreateReviewContextFromDisplayLayers previously copied every non-placeholder display layer into a new VisionPipelineContext. A retained A_Output therefore satisfied a B Run input even after B deleted, disabled, or reordered the producer, so the run could consume a stale derived image without an explicit branch decision.

problem.impact: A recipe edit could silently inspect an image produced by an earlier run instead of the declared current source, making result provenance and failure behavior dependent on workspace residue.

criteria.text: Review context creation excludes all output layers declared by the current effective pipeline, including disabled or reordered producers, so a producer-missing input fails closed at execution.

Output layers actually produced by an earlier Review run in the same document remain excluded when the producer is deleted, while default Main and newly supplied non-produced external layers retain their existing input behavior.

An existing ALLOW_BRANCH_INPUT=true step can explicitly consume a prior layer, and affected Review generation, cache lifetime, stale callback, document revision, duplicate identity, and focused Debug build checks pass without Original or external mutation.

context.location: OpenVisionPipelineReviewExecutionController.RunAsync owns the effective pipeline and Review context admission; CreateReviewContextFromDisplayLayers selects display seeds; ReplaceReviewStepImage records Review-produced output-layer provenance; VisionPipelineExecutionService owns missing-input failure; the focused PipelineReviewRunInputIsolationContract owns the A/B run fixture.

The execution controller owns the run-scoped and document-lived reviewProducedOutputLayers set. DisplayManager remains the workspace image owner; VisionPipelineContext is a per-Run disposable snapshot and never writes workspace layers.

OpenVisionPipelineReviewExecutionController.cs -> VisionPipelineNormalizer.cs (ALLOW_BRANCH_INPUT) -> VisionPipelineExecutionService.cs -> PipelineReviewRunInputIsolationContract.cs -> stable feature contracts and current handoff.

evidence.observation: Source review confirmed that the old context builder copied every non-placeholder display layer. The changed owner now computes current output layers, unions output layers produced by earlier Review steps, and removes only non-current outputs explicitly opted in by ALLOW_BRANCH_INPUT before seeding the disposable context.

The pre-patch contract reproduced the gap: after an A Run output was retained as A_Output, deleted-producer, disabled-producer, and reordered-producer B cases all consumed that layer; the explicit branch case passed. This is the baseline evidence for the source fix.

The post-change focused contract passed: deleted, disabled, and reordered producer cases failed with Input layer 'A_Output' has no image instead of consuming the retained output, and ALLOW_BRANCH_INPUT=true recovered the explicitly permitted external branch.
Existing Review execution-generation, image-cache lifetime, stale-callback, document revision, and duplicate Step identity contracts all passed against the changed Debug binary.

VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke Debug build completed with 0 warnings and 0 errors. No desktop EXE or WPF UI interaction was launched in this slice; theme, DPI, monitor, and native hardware coverage remain unverified.

events.summary: Reuse the existing Review execution controller and VisionPipelineNormalizer branch opt-in. Exclude current and previously Review-produced output layers from context seeding, preserve Main, and do not add a pipeline-format migration or new provenance service.

PL-0070 resolved after the baseline stale-layer reproduction, post-change input-isolation contract, lifecycle regressions, and focused Debug build passed; no Original or external mutation was performed.
